verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs say Gemini in Gmail can "Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar," which directly covers sharing availability from within Gmail. The support is a single one-line mention: there is no evidence of bookable or clickable time slots inserted into the email body, and no detail on how proposed times appear in the message. missing for 10: insertable bookable time slots or booking links in the compose window, documentation of how proposed times are embedded in the email, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
